catalog_title: MASTER AI — PHASE 6.4 GITHUB REPOSITORY CATALOG
target_platform: Windows 11 Enterprise (Intel Core i5-1245U, 32GB RAM, Iris Xe)

repositories.name: FireRed-OpenStoryline
repositories.description: Open-source AI video editing agent shifting production from manual cutting to intention-driven directing. Uses LLM/VLM planning, MCP video editing tools, subtitle pacing, BGM integration, and reusable 'Style Skills'.
repositories.hardware_requirements: 16GB RAM, CPU supported for orchestration; GPU recommended for local VLM
repositories.required_apis: OpenAI / Claude / Local VLM API for intent planning
repositories.security_notes: Clean Apache-2.0 codebase; uses MCP tool boundary; requires API key for cloud LLM/VLM planning
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Directly integrates into Master AI via its MCP server tool interface. Perfectly complements Master AI's storyboard director and video editor agents.

repositories.name: openfilm
repositories.category: AI Video Production & Video as Code
repositories.description: Open-source AI video agent framework that turns coding agents into video producers. Represents films as web pages using deterministic frame(t) rendering, headless Chromium capture, and an interactive local Studio editor.
repositories.hardware_requirements: 8GB RAM, CPU rendering via Chromium headless
repositories.required_apis: None required for rendering; optional BYO-key for AI media generators
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; runs fully local; executes local JavaScript inside headless browser sandbox
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Runs seamlessly on Master AI's existing Node.js 24 and FFmpeg stack. Enables Master AI agents to produce high-resolution motion graphics and procedural title cards via HTML/CSS/Canvas.

repositories.name: socialdrop
repositories.description: Local-first video publishing pipeline tool automating distribution across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, and Bluesky. Watches local folders for video files and JSON/Markdown metadata sidecars, uploading via platform APIs and updating sidecars with live links.
repositories.required_apis: Target social platform API tokens (YouTube Data API, Meta Graph API, etc.)
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; requires local secure credential storage for OAuth refresh tokens; enforces file-based approval boundary
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Directly matches Master AI's existing 'publication_bundle/PUBLICATION_METADATA.json' staging pattern. Can be triggered upon ApprovalCenter ticket authorization.

repositories.name: Wan2.1
repositories.description: State-of-the-art open video foundation model suite supporting 1.3B and 14B parameters. Delivers text-to-video, image-to-video, video editing, and bilingual text rendering at 480p/720p.
repositories.runtime: Linux / Windows (WSL2) with NVIDIA GPU; Cloud API
repositories.hardware_requirements: 1.3B requires 8-12GB VRAM; 14B requires 24-80GB VRAM (impractical on Intel Iris Xe CPU)
repositories.required_apis: None locally; requires cloud endpoint (Replicate/fal.ai) for CPU hosts
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0 license; large model downloads (>10GB); must be routed via cloud inference provider for CPU-only hardware
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Outstanding video generation quality, but local execution impossible on Intel Iris Xe. Must be integrated as a gated Cloud AI visual provider behind ApprovalCenter.

repositories.name: LTX-Video
repositories.description: Fast 0.9B parameter Diffusion Transformer (DiT) model generating 768x512 video clips at 24fps in seconds. Designed for high efficiency and local consumer hardware.
repositories.runtime: Linux / Windows with CUDA or cloud inference
repositories.hardware_requirements: 6-8GB VRAM with CUDA; CPU inference very slow (>15 min/clip)
repositories.integration_type: Python Library / ComfyUI Node / Cloud API
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0 code and weights; clean safety boundaries
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Smallest and fastest modern open video DiT, but requires CUDA. Best integrated via serverless cloud worker or cloud API.

repositories.name: HunyuanVideo
repositories.description: Tencent's flagship 13B parameter open-source video generation model. Delivers cinematic 720p/1080p photorealistic motion with complex multi-character dynamics.
repositories.license: Tencent Hunyuan Community License / Apache-2.0 code
repositories.security_notes: Tencent community license; requires review for enterprise commercial threshold; high compute footprint
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Exceptional documentary-grade fidelity; cloud-only deployment model.

repositories.name: CogVideo
repositories.description: CogVideoX-2B and CogVideoX-5B text-to-video models utilizing 3D causal VAEs and expert transformer architectures to generate 6-second high-coherence video clips.
repositories.hardware_requirements: CogVideoX-2B runs in 11GB VRAM with INT8; 5B requires 18GB+ VRAM
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0 licensed; wide community adoption across ComfyUI ecosystem
repositories.compatibility_rationale: High video coherence, ideal for stock nature and wildlife b-roll generation via cloud API.

repositories.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
repositories.description: Automates the generation of viral YouTube Shorts and TikTok videos by orchestrating AI scriptwriting, stock video retrieval (Pexels), TTS voiceover generation, and automatic subtitle burning.
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; requires external Pexels API key; uses subprocess moviepy rendering
repositories.compatibility_rationale: High code overlap with Master AI's Phase 6 pipeline. Excellent architectural patterns for Pexels stock video fetching and subtitle positioning.

repositories.name: ShortGPT
repositories.description: Modular video automation engine for creating YouTube Shorts, documentary shorts, and TikToks. Offers voiceover synthesis, automated video editing, multi-language asset management, and captions.
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; inactive maintenance in recent months; relies on older moviepy 1.0
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Valuable for reference architecture and prompts, but inactive maintenance makes direct adoption less desirable than native FFmpeg.

repositories.name: ComfyUI
repositories.description: Most widely used node-based visual pipeline engine for Stable Diffusion, Flux, Wan2.1, and HunyuanVideo. Provides graph execution, API mode, and custom node extensibility.
repositories.hardware_requirements: CPU mode exists but is extremely slow; GPU strongly recommended
repositories.required_apis: None locally; runs local server with WebSocket/REST API
repositories.security_notes: GPL-3.0 license requires isolation via REST API client to avoid copyleft infection; third-party custom nodes pose arbitrary code execution risks
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Best deployed as an isolated external service on a GPU cloud instance or local GPU workstation, connected to Master AI via REST API.

repositories.name: diffusers
repositories.description: State-of-the-art pretrained diffusion models for generating images, audio, and video. Serves as the standard Python library for Flux, SDXL, Wan2.1, CogVideoX, and LTX-Video.
repositories.hardware_requirements: Varies by model; CPU-only pipeline supported for lightweight tasks
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0; trusted library audited by Hugging Face; pickle security handled via safetensors
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Standard foundation library for all AI visual pipelines in Python.

repositories.name: PySceneDetect
repositories.description: Python library and CLI tool for detecting scene changes and cuts in video files, splitting videos into individual shots, and exporting cut lists for editing.
repositories.security_notes: Permissive BSD-3-Clause license; runs 100% offline with no network calls
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Essential for automated video editing, b-roll footage analysis, and QA validation of scene transitions.

repositories.name: auto-editor
repositories.description: Automated video and audio rough-cutter. Analyzes loudness, motion, and subtitle data to strip silent pauses and dead air, exporting to Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro XML, or direct MP4.
repositories.security_notes: Unlicense / Public domain; completely offline; lightweight and battle-tested
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Solves the audio pacing and pause-trimming problem automatically, ensuring high video retention without manual editing.

repositories.name: pyvideotrans
repositories.description: End-to-end video translation, dubbing, and subtitle synchronization tool. Extracts audio, performs Whisper ASR, translates scripts, synthesizes neural voiceover, and burns multilingual subtitles.
repositories.security_notes: GPL-3.0 license requires out-of-process CLI/service integration; clean offline architecture
repositories.compatibility_rationale: High relevance for multilingual localization (English to Hindi dubbing). Should be called as a subprocess or CLI tool to avoid GPL copyleft taint.

repositories.name: Remotion
repositories.description: Create professional MP4 videos programmatically using React, TailwindCSS, Canvas, and WebGL. Renders frame-by-frame via headless browser into FFmpeg at 4K resolution.
repositories.license: Company-Specific (Free for individuals and small companies <3 employees; paid commercial license for enterprise)
repositories.commercial_use: RESTRICTED (Remotion license requires paid commercial license for companies with >3 employees)
repositories.cost: FREEMIUM (Free for small businesses; commercial license required for scale)
repositories.security_notes: Proprietary license considerations for enterprise; Node.js execution sandbox
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Powerful for React-based motion graphics, but openfilm (MIT) or native FFmpeg is preferred due to Remotion's commercial licensing restrictions.

repositories.name: pyWikiCommons
repositories.description: Lightweight Python wrapper for searching, querying metadata, verifying licenses, and downloading public-domain / CC-0 media files from Wikimedia Commons.
repositories.required_apis: Wikimedia Commons MediaWiki API (Public, no auth needed)
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; verifies HTTP endpoints; rate-limits requests gracefully per Wikimedia policy
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Directly remedies the Phase 6.3 audit finding! Enables Master AI to search real Wikimedia Commons files, verify actual CC-0/Public Domain licenses, and download real wildlife media.

repositories.name: pexels-api-python
repositories.subcategory: Pexels Stock Video & Photo API Client
repositories.description: Python client for the Pexels REST API. Enables searching and downloading royalty-free, commercially usable 1080p and 4K stock videos, animal footage, and nature photography.
repositories.commercial_use: ALLOWED (Pexels license permits commercial YouTube use without mandatory attribution)
repositories.required_apis: Pexels API Key (Free tier: 200 req/hr, 20,000 req/month)
repositories.cost: FREE (Free tier covers all Master AI testing)
repositories.security_notes: Requires API key stored in .env.local; zero credential leakage
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Allows Master AI to acquire real 1080p wildlife footage (lions, savannas, nature) legally and free for commercial YouTube documentary production.

repositories.name: yt-dlp
repositories.description: Feature-rich command-line and Python library for downloading videos, extracting subtitles, querying metadata, and inspecting media streams across thousands of web video platforms.
repositories.security_notes: Public Domain; extremely active community; can parse Creative Commons YouTube video metadata
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Indispensable for research, transcript extraction, Creative Commons media acquisition, and competitive YouTube analysis.

repositories.name: internetarchive
repositories.description: Official Python library and CLI tool for searching, cataloging, and retrieving public domain historical footage, nature recordings, and CC-0 audio/video from archive.org.
repositories.security_notes: AGPL-3.0 license mandates out-of-process execution (CLI) to protect Master AI codebase
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Accesses millions of authentic historical and public domain nature films; requires CLI boundary due to AGPL-3.0.

repositories.name: faster-whisper
repositories.description: Reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2. Delivers up to 4x faster transcription speed with 8-bit quantization on CPU and GPU, supporting Hindi and 98 other languages.
repositories.hardware_requirements: Runs on CPU (Intel i5-1245U) using int8 quantization; ~1.5GB RAM for 'base'/'small' model
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; 100% local; zero telemetry; resolves linguistic intelligibility gap
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Directly resolves the Phase 6.3 linguistic intelligibility gap! Can transcribe Hindi speech offline on CPU in seconds, enabling automated Word Error Rate (WER) verification.

repositories.name: sherpa-onnx
repositories.subcategory: Offline Embedded ASR and TTS via ONNX Runtime
repositories.description: Zero-dependency offline speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and speaker identification framework powered by ONNX Runtime. Fully supports Hindi ASR (Whisper, Zipformer) and Hindi TTS (VITS, Piper) on CPU.
repositories.runtime: Windows / Linux / macOS / Android / iOS / WebAssembly
repositories.hardware_requirements: Extremely lightweight; runs on CPU with <1GB RAM
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0 license; pure ONNX inference; zero cloud dependencies
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Ideal lightweight CPU engine for Master AI. Provides both Hindi TTS and Hindi ASR in a single, robust, zero-paid dependency.

repositories.name: edge-tts
repositories.description: Python library allowing text-to-speech synthesis using Microsoft Edge's online text-to-speech service without an Azure account or API key. Provides high-quality neural voices in Hindi (Madhur, Swara) and 100+ languages.
repositories.commercial_use: RESTRICTED (GPL-3.0 library; Microsoft Service Terms apply to audio output)
repositories.security_notes: GPL-3.0; already upgraded to 7.3.1 in Master AI .venv; Microsoft Sec-MS-GEC v2 protocol rotation mitigated
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Currently power Master AI's Phase 6.2 neural Hindi speech synthesis. Highly effective zero-paid audio solution.

repositories.name: whisperX
repositories.description: High-accuracy speech recognition with word-level phonetic alignment and speaker diarization. Uses faster-whisper and wav2vec2 alignment models to output exact millisecond timestamps.
repositories.security_notes: BSD-2-Clause license; local execution; highly accurate for subtitle alignment
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Elevates Master AI subtitle synchronization to professional broadcast grade with millisecond-exact word-level highlight capabilities.

repositories.name: Indic-TTS
repositories.description: Multi-speaker neural text-to-speech models for 13 Indian languages (including Hindi) using FastPitch acoustic models and HiFi-GAN vocoders. Open-source, culturally nuanced intonation.
repositories.hardware_requirements: CPU inference supported for single batches; 4GB RAM
repositories.required_apis: None (offline model weights on Hugging Face)
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; research-grade checkpoints; high-quality native Hindi prosody
repositories.compatibility_rationale: The premier open-source academic model for authentic Hindi accents. Can be exported to ONNX for fast CPU inference.

repositories.name: vosk-api
repositories.description: Offline speech recognition toolkit running on Kaldi. Supports Hindi, English, and 20+ languages with models starting from 50MB. Operates with sub-100ms latency on CPU.
repositories.security_notes: Apache-2.0; zero network footprint; zero cloud tracking
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Fastest zero-GPU Hindi ASR check for real-time speech verification in Master AI's automated quality gates.

repositories.name: audiocraft
repositories.subcategory: Generative Music and Sound Effects Engine
repositories.description: Deep learning library for audio generation featuring MusicGen (text-to-music), AudioGen (text-to-sound effects), and EnCodec. Generates documentary soundscapes and cinematic orchestral scores.
repositories.runtime: Linux / Windows (GPU required for reasonable speed)
repositories.required_apis: None locally; cloud API alternatives (e.g. Stable Audio Open)
repositories.security_notes: CC-BY-NC 4.0 license prevents commercial monetization of generated music tracks; must be audited strictly in licensing gates
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Impressive music quality, but non-commercial weight license poses legal risk for commercial YouTube channels. Procedural CC-0 / FreeMusicArchive alternatives preferred.

repositories.name: postiz-app
repositories.subcategory: Open-Source Social Media Scheduling & MCP Server
repositories.description: AI-powered open-source social media scheduling tool. Supports multi-platform distribution across YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Reddit. Provides REST API and official MCP server.
repositories.security_notes: AGPL-3.0 requires clean architectural separation via HTTP/MCP; securely stores user OAuth credentials; web UI for post scheduling
repositories.compatibility_rationale: The most complete open-source multi-platform publisher available. Integrates cleanly into Master AI via its native MCP server without AGPL code contagion.

repositories.name: youtube-upload
repositories.subcategory: CLI YouTube Uploader via Official API
repositories.description: Command-line script to upload videos to YouTube using the official YouTube Data API v3. Supports chunked uploads, resumable uploads, privacy status, tags, and category assignment.
repositories.required_apis: Google Cloud YouTube Data API v3 credentials
repositories.security_notes: GPL-3.0; uses official Google OAuth2 tokens; executes as standalone CLI subprocess
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Lightweight, battle-tested CLI tool for YouTube publishing upon ApprovalCenter ticket sign-off.

repositories.name: social-auto-upload
repositories.description: Automates video publishing to TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu using official APIs and headless Playwright browser automation.
repositories.security_notes: Uses browser automation for platforms without public upload APIs; requires careful session cookie handling
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Fills the gap for platforms lacking open public video upload APIs (like TikTok and Instagram Reels).

repositories.name: langgraph
repositories.description: Library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs, featuring cyclic computational graphs, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, memory persistence, and time-travel debugging.
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; clean state checkpoints; native human-in-the-loop approval support
repositories.compatibility_rationale: Directly mirrors Master AI's Phase 5 multi-agent state machine. Excellent patterns for graph-based production pipelines.

repositories.name: browser-use
repositories.description: Make websites accessible for AI agents. Enables autonomous browsing, form filling, research, media scraping, and cross-platform publishing using Playwright and vision-language models.
repositories.required_apis: Vision LLM (e.g. Qwen2.5-VL via Ollama or Claude/GPT-4o)
repositories.security_notes: MIT licensed; executes real browser interactions; requires sandbox constraints against unintended navigations
repositories.compatibility_rationale: High-value capability for automated stock footage discovery, copyright clearance checks, and web-based publishing workflows.
